name: Onehub
about: Watches Onehub and checks portal.cmicshare.com (CMiC File Share) directly; an outage stops customers downloading files such as software and guides.
details: Reads Onehub's status page, and also opens portal.cmicshare.com's public sign-in page every run, with no login. Two failed checks in a row mark it down, and it warns 14 days before the site's security certificate expires. Customers use the File Share portal to download files such as software and guides.
label: :file_folder: *Onehub / CMiC File Share Status*
